name: Record carrier claim receipt
goal: Record the shipper-provided carrier confirmation and start local 30- and 120-day status follow-ups. These are reminders for parcel carriers; LTL response periods apply only when 49 CFR Part 370 governs.

config.template:
Customer-provided carrier receipt confirmation recorded. Local status-check reminders start from this reported receipt date. For an LTL claim governed by 49 CFR Part 370, the tracker shows a 30-day acknowledgment check, a 120-day disposition/status check, and a 60-day repeat interval if still pending. Record the actual carrier notices and next follow-up date. For parcel carriers, record any response date the carrier actually gives; the reminders are not carrier promises.

{summary}

acceptance.cmd: python -c "import os,json,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path(os.environ['GLACIER_HOME'])/'ventures/freight-claims/reports'; rows=[json.loads(x.read_text()) for x in p.glob('receipt-*.json')]; assert rows and all(r.get('deadline_rule') == '30d|120d' and r.get('carrier_reference') and r.get('side_effects') == [] for r in rows)"
